Return a bounded inventory of discoverable operations and ownership.

Usage:
  tadx capability list [flags]

Flags:
      --cursor string     continue from a prior result cursor
      --domain string     filter by exact command domain
  -h, --help              help for list
      --limit int         maximum capabilities to return (default 20)
      --mutation          filter by remote mutation status
      --owner string      filter by exact owner
      --product string    filter by product availability
      --resource string   filter by exact resource

Global Flags:
      --config string   path to the non-secret TADX configuration file
      --full            show expanded bounded details
